finding.technique_name: Use Alternate Authentication Material: Application Access Token
finding.rationale: Application access token reuse allows an adversary who captures a delegated token to impersonate the victim account for the token's remaining lifetime without re-authenticating. When the compromised account holds Directory Readers or a broader directory role, the replayed token enables full tenant enumeration across users, groups, and role assignments. Scoping service and monitoring accounts to the minimum required role (e.g., a custom limited-read role rather than Directory Readers) reduces the blast radius of token theft and limits what an adversary can enumerate during the valid token window.
